title: danthonia californica var. americana
intro: Danthonia californica var. americana, commonly known as California oat grass or American Danthonia, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It is traditionally used to support lung health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues due to its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to expectorate mucus, reduce fever, and soothe coughs. The bioactive constituents of Danthonia californica var. americana include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
